name: Chat Panel
description: Copilot-style assistant side panel with message list, tool call cards, model badge, and composer with send/stop states.

props.name: messages
props.description: Required. Conversation turns with id, role, content and optional timestamp, toolCalls and streaming flag. Example: messages={[{ id: "1", role: "user", content: "Hi" }]}

props.name: title
props.description: Header label of the panel. Example: title="Copilot"

props.name: model
props.description: Model badge shown next to the title. Example: model="gpt-5"

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text of the composer input. Example: placeholder="Ask anything"

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the composer while the panel is read-only. Example: disabled={!connected}

props.name: onSendMessage
props.description: Called with the trimmed composer text when the user sends. Example: onSendMessage={(text) => send(text)}

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the user stops a streaming answer. Example: onStop={abort}

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class names for the panel. Example: className="h-[600px]"
